title: Property Securing Charge in Retention Payoff Approvals
content:
## Property securing charge — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the property securing charge enters the retention balance figure.

**Rule.** The property securing charge is USD 285.00, the vacant-property securing fee, when the latest inspection result recorded on the loan's occupancy profile under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product found the home vacant, and USD 85.00, the unconfirmed-occupancy securing fee, when that result was unable to determine, in each case only where the plan of the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product permits vacant-property securing; any other result, no result, or a plan that does not permit vacant-property securing carries nothing (0.00).

**Results on the same day.** Where several inspection results on the occupancy profile share the latest effective date, a vacant finding among them counts as the latest result, and otherwise an unable-to-determine finding does.

### Truth table

| Securing permitted | Latest inspection result | Property securing charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | vacant | USD 285.00 |
| yes | unable to determine | USD 85.00 |
| yes | occupied, any other result, or none | nothing |
| no | any | nothing |

The amount is the same whatever the property type and however long the home has been vacant.
